body.x: Exterior building joints move, and the sealant has to keep bonding through that movement. Structural glazing, stone and panel joints, insulating glass, bathrooms and fire-rated penetrations each call for a different formulation, and each is tested against its own standard.

TOPSEAL Co., Ltd., a construction silicone specialist led by Jong Yeub Lee, exhibited its sealant lineup at the 57th Korea Electronics Show (KES 2026), held from Oct. 13 to 16 at COEX in Seoul. The company is looking for overseas partners in silicone OEM and local production, as well as distributors and dealers who can supply the TOPSEAL brand through local sales networks.

The structural and non-staining exterior line is built around 793, 966 and 967. 793 is a structural glazing (SSG) silicone that conforms to ASTM C 1184 and C 920, with a minimum tensile strength of 2.0 N/mm² and a minimum elongation of 600%. Product 966 has been tested for staining in accordance with ASTM C1248. The exterior joint products 793, 966 and 967 offer a movement capability of ±25%.

Prime-X, a premium glazing sealant, meets KS G-30SHM. It is a neutral-cure type with a low irritating odor and almost no metal corrosion, and it maintains elasticity from minus 50 to 150 degrees Celsius. For insulating glass, IGS606 (one-component) and IG969 (two-component) are dedicated to the secondary sealing of insulating glass units.

The BIO bathroom series, Bathtub-X and Bathtub-N, holds a mold-resistance test report (LHCS 41 40 12:2020) and is eco-friendly certified. The 1002 is made for balcony and window perimeters and carries Eco-Friendly Building Material certification at the 5 Clovers rating. On the fire-resistant side, F200 is used in fire-rated zones such as power plants and clean rooms and for sealing cable pits and penetrations, alongside 489. The lineup also includes the heat-resistant 730.

Major products follow KS F 4910 grades, including G-30SHM, F-25HM, F-25LM and F-12.5E. Certifications have been obtained product by product: ISO 9001 and 14001, Eco-Friendly Building Material certification (966 and 1002 at 5 Clovers), Indoor Mark, Environmental Product Declaration (carbon footprint and low-carbon), Environmental Label, fire-resistance structure approval testing and UL. Every LOT is inspected for appearance, tack-free time, viscosity, slump, non-volatile content and specific gravity, and every batch is inspected for tensile strength and elongation (ASTM D412), hardness and adhesion.

The company says many of its products bond to most substrates without a primer and that its one-component types make installation easier. It also says a single brand covering structural, exterior, glazing, bathroom, fire-resistant and insulating glass applications widens the range of products customers can choose from.

Founded in 2000, TOPSEAL researches, develops, produces and supplies silicone, modified silicone, urethane and acrylic sealants, polyurethane foam and the TOP FIX adhesive product line. It filed the TOPSEAL brand in 2011 and began its silicone manufacturing business. The company holds certifications as a venture company (2010), an Inno-Biz company (2011) and a corporate R&D center (2012). Its stated vision is to be "a sustainable-growth company that moves forward together with customers, built on trust and technology."

The company has installed its products at more than 340 sites in Korea, including apartment complexes by major construction firms, educational, medical and public facilities, logistics centers and data centers, advanced factories and integrated resorts. Projects include Mapo Seogyo Xi West Valley, Incheon St. Mary's Hospital New Building, Gimpo Hangang New Town Suzain, Gajaeul New Town e-Pyeonhan Sesang, the Asan Tangjeong District SMD A3 Project, Konkuk University Science Building and Goyang Siksa Xi.

Sales in 2025 were about KRW 81.8 billion. Export sales were about KRW 11.3 billion, up about 29% from a year earlier and roughly 14% of total sales. TOPSEAL won Export Tower awards for USD 3 million (2017), USD 5 million (2020) and USD 10 million (2021). Its recognitions include Top 100 Excellent Companies of Chungbuk (2013), a commendation for exemplary SME entrepreneur (2018), Youth-Friendly Strong Small Company (2019 and 2021), Best Jobs Company (2019), Chungcheongbuk-do Regional Leading Industry SME (2020) and the Grand Prize for SME Regulatory Innovation of Korea (2021).

TOPSEAL exports to 13 countries: the United States, Australia, Japan, India, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Bahrain, the Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia and Myanmar. Its overseas bases include Sungwon Topspra, an affiliate in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu Province, China (2014), and a U.S. branch office (2021). To increase exports and attract new customers, it aims to expand into the United States, Japan, Mexico and the Philippines.

The company plans to expand overseas in three directions: silicone OEM services for overseas customers, more exports of silicone cartridges, and local production with direct supply systems abroad. Through these efforts, it aims to reach the VISION 2030 target of KRW 200 billion or more in sales.

The 57th Korea Electronics Show (KES 2026) ran from Oct. 13 (Tuesday) to 16 (Friday) in Halls A and B at COEX in Seoul. The Korea Electronics Association (KEA) organized the show, and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources hosted it. The KES website lists 500 exhibitors and 1,100 booths. Its themes included electronic parts and materials such as sensors, connectors, printed circuit boards (PCBs) and power supplies; AI transformation (AX) fields such as generative AI, on-device AI, AI chips and smart home and wearable devices; mobility; robotics; digital health; ESG; and Web 3.0 and XR. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event featured X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony took place on Oct. 13.
